question: Which of the following is INCORRECT?
solution:
The correct answer is 1 GB= 220 byte [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1 GB = 220 byte**: This statement is incorrect because it suggests that 1 GB is equal to 2202²⁰220 bytes, which is actually 1 MB (Megabyte).
 
• Here are the sizes of some storage units in a computer system:
 
• Kilobyte (KB): 210 bytes
 
• Megabyte (MB): 220 bytes
 
• Gigabyte (GB): 230 bytes
 
• Terabyte (TB): 240 bytes 
 
• Larger storage units include petabytes (PB), exabytes (EB), zettabytes (ZB), and yottabytes (YB)
